scope: Review of the 56 hypotheses whose names had a checked fact held back in rounds 129–130.

kept_unchanged.reason: The hypothesis text already contains the same checked record.

rule: A source that states the relation the hypothesis asked about (Senn–Salys: Adas and Nina as short forms, Fortunatas, Odilija and Otilija as Lithuanian forms) resolves it into a reviewed history. A record that only documents the exact form (date, place, calendar day, guide listing) is added as a separate paragraph and the Hypothesis label stays, following the existing Juozapotas pattern. Hypothesis objects shared between names are copied before the paragraph is added.

correction.issue: Round 129 period parser read II/III/IV quarters as the first quarter (regex alternation order).

next: New sources are needed for the ~3,060 names still without a history (see NAMEDAYS_TASKS.md).
